what_it_does: Provides a systematic comparison of two programming abstractions for managing fine-grained parallel tasks in distributed systems: traditional stackful coroutines (which allocate a full stack for each task) and C++20 stackless coroutines (which use compiler transformation). The study measures overhead in task creation, context switching, and memory usage when these coroutines are used with RDMA (remote direct memory access) for efficient inter-machine communication.
